Bullet Points (卖点描述 · 8条 · FABE原则 · 遵循主图叙事线)

  • Your Complex Yard, Made Simple — Flagship AWD robotic mowing for lawns up to 0.75 acre / 32,000 sq ft. Whether your yard has slopes, trees, narrow paths, or uneven ground — X7 Gen 2 handles it all so you don't have to. Set up in minutes with no buried wire, no base station, no hassle. Just charge, map, and let it mow.
  • Navigate Confidently, Even Under Trees — AONavi™ 2.0 combines Network RTK with VSLAM 2.0 (binocular + iToF cameras) for centimeter-level accuracy — no local base station needed. When satellite signals fade under dense tree cover, VSLAM seamlessly takes over so navigation never drops. Standard 4G module enables cloud RTK without any antenna setup.
  • Climb Slopes Your Yard Actually Has — Tri-wheel independent AWD with the ATC (All-Terrain Conquer) system tackles slopes up to 70% / 35° — wet grass, loose soil, potholes, and ruts included. Front independent suspension absorbs bumps for stable driving. The hill-hold system keeps a laser-straight line on sideslopes — no sliding, no second pass.
  • Turn Without Tearing Your Turf — The rear active steering motor turns independently through corners, so your grass stays protected from wheel marks. Unlike rigid-axle mowers that pivot and dig, X7 Gen 2 glides through turns with turf-first engineering — because a great mow shouldn't come at the cost of your lawn's health.
  • A Wide Cut That Follows the Ground — 14-inch dual cutting discs with 12 blades cover more ground per pass at 2,600 RPM. The floating deck adapts to every contour from 0.8" to 4.0" — electronically adjustable via app, no bending required. Set a target height and the mower auto-adjusts passes for a perfectly even finish on tall or dense grass.
  • See Obstacles Day and Night — Vision AI 2.0 with a 10 TOPS chip (10 trillion ops/sec) detects 360+ object types in any lighting. Binocular cameras map the yard by day; iToF active depth sensing takes over at dusk and after dark. From trampolines to garden hoses to chairs left on the lawn — it sees them and adjusts the route in real time.
  • Your Lawn Plan, in Your App — Edit virtual boundaries, create no-go zones, and manage unlimited mowing areas from your phone. Schedule each zone independently. Choose from multiple mowing patterns to create professional lawn stripes. Spot cutting targets missed patches without re-mowing the whole yard. Night mode, rain detection, and auto-recharge keep everything running hands-free.
  • Add Location Tracking to Your Setup — Optional 4G-GPS anti-theft module supports real-time tracking, adjustable geofencing, and boundary alerts — so you always know where your mower is. Backed by a 2-year warranty, 30-day exchange, and US-based local support — real experts by phone and chat, 7 days a week. CES 2026 Innovation Honoree.

Product Description

Large Lawn. Tough Terrain. Made Simple.

The Sunseeker X7 Gen 2 is built for homeowners with complex yards — slopes, trees, narrow passages, and uneven ground. It's not just a mower that reaches these areas; it's one that handles them confidently, consistently, and without your intervention.

Navigate without a base station. AONavi™ 2.0 with Network RTK provides centimeter-level accuracy straight from the cloud. When satellite signals weaken under tree cover, VSLAM 2.0 with iToF depth sensing takes over — day or night.

Conquer real terrain. The ATC (All-Terrain Conquer) system — tri-wheel AWD, independent suspension, and rear active steering — climbs 70% slopes, absorbs rough ground, and turns without tearing your turf.

Cut wider, adjust smarter. 14-inch dual cutting discs float with the ground contours, electronically adjustable from 0.8" to 4.0" via the app. Set a target height and the mower calculates the passes for you.

See everything. 10 TOPS Vision AI 2.0 detects 360+ objects — binocular by day, iToF by night. From trampolines to garden hoses, it sees them and moves around them.

Manage from anywhere. Unlimited zones, virtual boundaries, spot cutting, lawn art patterns, night mode, rain detection, auto-recharge — all from the Sunseeker Smart App.

Optional 4G-GPS anti-theft module available. 2-year warranty. US local support. CES 2026 Innovation Honoree.
